name: Sichuan New Energy Power Company Limited
summary: Sichuan New Energy Power Company Limited engages in the wind power, photovoltaic power, and waste-to-energy power generation activities in China. It operates through Wind Power Business, Environmental Protection Business, Lithium Battery Business, and Other Business segments. The company is involved in the development, construction, and operation of wind power and photovoltaic power generation projects; and investment and operation of waste incineration power generation projects and integrated urban sanitation services.
